notes: Third station block of Table 6 (duration estimates of daily specific conductance based on the specific conductance-discharge relation and the duration of daily mean discharge for selected sites in the Eel River): specific conductance against percent of time exceeded, plus the maximum (441) and minimum (90) specific conductance of record. Not a time series. The dates given are the period the block heading prints for the data the estimates rest on ("Specific conductance: October 1951 through January 1975"; "Discharge: October 1951 through September 1973"); the rules do not say whether a duration table takes these dates or none. No county or state on the page.
